name: More blocks
description: Adds a "More Blocks" palette category with hidden-but-functional vanilla blocks carried over from Scratch 2.0: while, for each, all at once, and the counter blocks. These save as ordinary Scratch blocks, so projects that use them still run for people who don't have Scratch Addons.

info.text: These are real Scratch blocks that were removed from the palette but still run correctly. Projects using them work for everyone, even without Scratch Addons.
